turns.user: I have a Budapest pass. Can I get the cheaper ticket for bus 100E?
turns.agent:
Possibly—but I need to know which Budapest pass you have to tell whether the 1,000 HUF 100E add-on applies. The 5 November 2026 snapshot says a qualifying valid Budapest pass can be combined with the add-on, but the 15-day Budapest pass and monthly pass for job seekers are excluded. The add-on is for one 100E trip only. BKK: Add-on airport shuttle bus single ticket

If your pass doesn’t qualify, the snapshot lists the full-price 100E ticket at 2,500 HUF. BKK: Airport shuttle bus single ticket

What’s the exact name or duration of your pass—for example, monthly, 15-day, or 24-hour travelcard? A 24-hour travelcard is not a Budapest pass and does not qualify for the add-on.
